name: Strangely Marked Box
summary: On Darkshore, Strangely Marked Box runes point toward naga cargo washed ashore on dead sea turtles. Their presence hints that the turtles did not come ashore by chance.

sections.title: Trophies of the Deep
sections.body: Dead sea turtles and other sea creatures wash onto Darkshore’s beaches. Some bear broken harnesses and carriages strapped to their shells. Among the wreckage lie sealed boxes marked with foreign, winding runes. Greymist murlocs shelter in hollow ribs and broken wagons, feeding on the carcasses and guarding what remains.

sections.title: Evidence of Naga Expansion
sections.body: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, a researcher for the Temple of the Moon in Auberdine, recognizes the markings. The script and carriages belong to the naga, who use giant turtles to carry supplies and war equipment onto land. The boxes place naga along the northern shores and suggest they may be driving their mounts south toward Ashenvale. Auberdine's priesthood sends the relics to Darnassus for study.

faq.q: Where is the Strangely Marked Box found?
aliases: where to find strangely marked box
faq.answer: The box lies in an abandoned carriage strapped to a dead sea turtle on Darkshore's coast. Greymist murlocs feed near the carcasses and guard what remains.

faq.q: Who made the Strangely Marked Box?
faq.answer: The naga made the box and its inscriptions. They strap carriages to living sea turtles to carry provisions, arms, and equipment from the ocean depths to Kalimdor's shores.

faq.q: Who wants this box in Auberdine?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, a researcher for the Temple of the Moon in Auberdine, collects the box to study the strange beachings and the naga threat.

faq.q: Why were the sea turtles carrying these boxes?
faq.answer: The naga use giant sea turtles to carry supplies and war equipment onto land, with harnesses and carriages strapped to their backs. Gwennyth suspects one turtle was killed while heading south, perhaps toward Ashenvale.

faq.q: What happens to the box after giving it to Gwennyth?
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde sends the box and coastal survey findings to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, where the night elf leadership can study the naga's reach.

angles.text: Naga supply boxes lashed to native sea turtles along Darkshore warn the kaldorei that their ancient, mutated kin are pushing ashore from the Great Sea.
As a priest, you help the Temple of the Moon's scholars in Auberdine secure shore relics as they work to protect the coast from marine corruption.
